name: convention-require-through-create-require
description: A configuration file that declares require as the function createRequire returns still binds a top-level require of a row's module as an import of it, because that require is the platform's: the SolidStart plugin's appRoot option is read through it and moves the app directory, so the app file there is an entry. The fixture assumes the analyzer carries a row named solidstart for the package @solidjs/start whose range holds the installed version, whose entries hold <appRoot>/app.ts, and which reads appRoot from the options of solidStart imported from @solidjs/start/config in vite.config.mjs.
